description: Major acts with no tour on sale yet: rumoured 2027 tours (reason "rumoured", with the report that names them in source_url) and big names between tours ("between-tours"). Nothing here gets a page while it has no dates. Each day roster-candidates.yml and auto-promote.yml run scripts/artist-watchlist.mjs, which asks Ticketmaster how many upcoming events each open entry has; an entry with at least 8 (a tour, not a festival slot or one-off) goes first in that day's candidate list and must then pass the FULL D1-D5 screen (no relaxed request thresholds) under the normal daily/weekly caps. An artist that is already on the site is ignored, so entries can stay. A name belongs in this file or data/artist-requests.json, never both. Validate with `npm run artists:watchlist:check`. Runbook: docs/ARTIST_INGESTION.md.

artists.note: Reported (anonymous sources) to be planning a 2027 tour; nothing announced.
